headers.mt2: (The Epistle of Paul to the Colossians)

verses.text: \s1 Lawk karouknae
Kai Pawl, Cathut ngainae lahoi Jisuh Khrih e guncei lah kaawm e hoi, Timote ni Kolosa kho kaawm, Khrih thung kaawm e tami kathoungnaw hoi yuemkamcu e hmaunawnghanaw ca na patawn awh.

Jisuh Khrih hoi maimae Pa Cathut koe e lungmanae hoi lungmawngnae teh nangmouh koe awm lawiseh.   
\s1 Lunghawi lawk deinae
Nangmouh ni Khrih Jisuh hah na yuem awh teh,
tami kathoungnaw pueng hah na lungpataw awh tie ka thai awh dawkvah,

Lawkkatang kamthang lawk nangmouh ni na thai awh teh, na yuem awh e patetlah nangmouh hane ngaihawinae kalvan vah hmouk lah ao dawkvah, nangmouh hanelah pout laipalah ka ratoum awh teh, maimae Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e Pa Cathut e lungmanae teh ka pholen.

Hote kamthang teh talaivan pueng a kamthang toung dawkvah nangmouh koe totouh hai a pha toe. Cathut e lungmanae lawkkatang hah na thai awh teh na panue awh hnin hoi, a paw na paw awh, na roung awh e patetlah kho tangkuem vah a kampung van.
Hote hah Epaphras ni na cangkhai awh e patetlah na coe awh. Ahni teh, kaimouh lungpataw e thaw tawk hui, Jisuh Khrih e a san lah kaawm e a tho.

Muitha dawk lungpatawnae na tawn awh e ahni ni toungloung a dei.   
\s1 Muitha roung nahanelah ratoumnae
Hatdawkvah, nangmae kong ka thai awh nah hnin hoi nangmouh hanlah ratoumnae ka pâpout awh hoeh.

Ka ratoum awh e teh, Bawipa e lungang hringnae hoi na hring awh teh, bangpueng koe ama lung kahawi sak e lah na o awh nahan, kahawi e nuen aphunphun dawk a paw na paw awh nahan, Cathut panuenae dawk na roung awh nahan,
thaonae bahu hoi na kawi awh teh, khangnae hoi na lung a saw awh nahan,

angnae dawk kaawm e tami kathoungnaw e râw hah na coe thai awh nahanelah, na ka kamcu sak e Bawipa hah lunghawi nalaihoi na pholen awh thai nahan, lungangnae aphunphun, poukthainae aphunphun lahoi Cathut e a ngainae hah na panue awh thai nahan ouk ka ratoum.
Cathut ni hmonae thung hoi na rasa awh teh a lungpataw e Capa e ram dawk na paen awh.

Hote Capa e a thipaling lahoi, ratangnae tie yon ngaithoumnae teh coe awh.   
\s1 Akungtuen e Khrih
Capa teh mithmu hoeh e Cathut mei ka kamnuek sak e lah ao teh hnosak puengpa e lathueng vah camin lah ao.

Ahni pawlawk lahoi hnocawngca pueng teh sak e lah ao. Kalvan kaawm e hnocawngca hoi talai van kaawm e hno cawngca, hmu thai e hoi hmu thai hoeh e, bawitungkhung, uknae, kâtawnae bahunaw pueng teh ahni lahoi sak e lah ao teh a Capa hanelah sak e lah ao.
Ahni teh hnocawngca ao hoehnahlan ao toe. Ahni thungvah hnocawngca pueng teh a kamtue.
Hahoi, ahni teh kawhmoun e lû lah ao. Kamtawngnae lah kaawm niteh duenae koehoi camin lah ao dawkvah hnocawngca pueng e lathueng poung lah ao.
Bangkongtetpawiteh a cawngca pueng e kuepnae teh ahni dawk a kamtue.
Thingpalam dawk a rabawk e a thi lahoi, taran a roum sak teh, kalvanlae hno nakunghai, talailae hno nakunghai, hnocawngca pueng hah Capa lahoi Cathut hoi a kâmaihawi sak.
Ahmaloe teh kahawihoehe hno sak awh dawkvah, lungthung vah taran lah o awh teh Cathut hoi kâkapek awh.
Atu teh, takthai hoi kâkuem e tak dawk duenae lahoi kâmaihawi awh toe.

Bangkongtetpawiteh, na thai awh tangcoung e kamthang kahawi ngaihawinae dawk hoi, phen laipalah, kacaklah na yuem awh pawiteh, amae hmalah ka thoung e, tounhoehe lah na o sak nahane doeh. Het hateh, na thai a tangcoung e kalvan rahim kaawm e hnocawngca koe pathang lah kaawm e, kai Pawl nihai a san lah ka okhai e kamthang kahawi doeh.   
\s1 Pawl ni thaw tawknae
Atuvah amae tak tie kawhmoun hane kecu dawk Khrih e reithainae a panki rae hah ka takthai dawk ka kuep sak. Nangmouh hanelah reithai ka khangnae dawk ka konawm.
Ayan e se dawk hro lah ao eiteh, atuteh ngit pâpho sak hanelah tami kathoungnaw koe a pâpho e hro lah kaawm e Cathut e lawkkatang hah teh nangmouh hane kecu dawk kai koe a kuep sak toe.
Hottelah ka kuep sak e Cathut e a thaw ka cangkhai e lah kai teh ka o.

Jentelnaw ni hote hrolawk lah kaawm e bawinae teh banghloimaw a len tie hah tami kathoungnaw koehoi patuen panue sak hanlah Cathut ni a ngai. Hote hno teh nangmouh thung vah kaawm e ngaihawinae Khrih hah doeh.
Khrih Jisuh thung tami pueng kuepnae koe pha thai awh nahanlah tami pueng kâhruetcuetnae poe awh nateh, lungangnae aphunphun lahoi kamthang kahawi teh pâpho awh.
Hottelah kai teh a thaw ka tawk. Kai dawk a bahu ni na pathoup teh a hnosakthainae hoi ka panki teh ka tawk.
Nangmouh hoi Laodicea kho kaawm e taminaw hoi ka minhmai ka hmawt hoeh rae naw pueng hanelah banghloimaw ka panki teh ka kâroe tie hah panue sak hanelah ka ngai.
Hethateh, nangmouh lungpahawinae lah ao teh, lungpatawnae dawk lungthin kâsawmbawmnae hoi Pa Cathut hoi Khrih e hrolawk hah panue thai awh nahane doeh.
Hote Khrih dawkvah lungangnae hoi panuenae puengpa teh hro lah ao.
Apipatet e tami nihai dumyennae lawk hoi, na dumyen awh hoeh nahanlah hete lawk heh ka dei.

Takthai lahoi teh nangmouh hoi ka kâhlat nakunghai, ka muitha lahoi teh nangmouh hoi reirei ka o. Hatdawkvah, nangmouh ni kahawicalah na tawk awh e, Khrih Jisuh dawk kacaklah na yuem awh e naw hah ka hmu navah ka lunghawi.   
\s1 Khrih dawk hringnae hoi khoktakannae
Khrih Jisuh hah na yuem awh toung dawkvah Khrih dawk hring awh.
Ama thung tangpha kacaklah pabawt nateh a ma dawk na hring awh teh, na kamtu awh e patetlah yuemnae dawk cak awh nateh, lunghawilawkdeinae dawk hring awh.

Jisuh Khrih e a lawk dawk dawn laipalah tami ni a sak e hoi talaivan phunglam hah a dawn awh teh, ayawmyin e thoumthainae lahoi apipatet nihai na dumyen awh teh, na lawp awh hoeh nahan kâhruetcuet awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut a coungnae pueng hateh, Khrih tak dawk doeh ao.
Hote Bawipa teh hnosakthainae, uk thainae abuemlae lû lah ao teh maimouh kuepcingnae lah ao.
Khrih hoi kâkuen e vuensomanae lahoi, tak hoi kâkuen e takthai hah, rading awh nateh, tami e kut hoi laipalah e vuensomanae hah, hote Bawipa koehoi coe awh toe.
Hatdawkvah, Cathut ni a hnosak e yuemnae lahoi Baptisma dawk hmai pakawp lah o awh teh duenae koehoi a thawnae dawk yuemnae lahoi Khrih dawk hmai thaw sak lah o awh toe.
Sak payonnae hoi vuensoma hoehnae yon dawk kadout e nangmouh teh Cathut ni Khrih dawk cungtalah na hring sak teh, sakpayon e yon kaawm e pueng hah a ngaithoum toe.
Maimouh hoi ka kâtaran lah thut lah kaawm e hah, thingpalam dawk hetsinnae lahoi a takhoe teh, maimae rahak hoi a pâmen toe.
Hnosakthainae hoi bahu tawnnae hah hmantang vah a kamnue sak teh, thingpalam dawk hoi a tâ toe.
Hatdawkvah, na canei e, pawi hnin, thaparei hnin, sabbath hnin na sakyoe awh e dawkvah apipatet koehai lawkceng sak awh hanh.
Hotnaw hateh hmalah ka tâcawt hane a tâhlipnaw lah doeh ao. A tak teh Khrih ama doeh.
Lû hah kâuep laipalah, a kâoup awh teh amamouh ni a hmu hoeh e naw hah a noumcai awh. Muitha hringnae laipalah, kalvantami ka bawk e apipatet koehai kâdum sak awh hanh.
Lû koehoi doeh puengcang takthai pueng ni tha akawi awh teh, Cathut ngainae patetlah tak ni a roung thai.
Het talaivan phung dawk Jisuh Khrih hoi cungtalah, na dout awh toung pawiteh,
het talai tak a hring nathung vah bangkongmaw talai phung lah kaawm e tek hanh, patek hanh, kâbet hanh tie naw hah toungloung na tarawi a vaw.
Tami e kâpoelawknaw hoi kâcangkhainae dawk tarawinae pueng teh rawk kahmanae seng doeh.
Hot patetlah e kâlawknaw teh mahoima kaboumlah kâpacanae tho hoeh. Mahmawk bawknae, katang hoeh e kârahnoumnae, kârektapnae lah ao dawkvah a lungkaang e boiboe lah a kâsak awh.
Ka dei tangcoung e patetlah nangmouh teh Khrih hoi cungtalah na thaw awh toung pawiteh Khrih ni Pa e aranglah a tahungnae hmuen koe kaawm e kahlun lae hno tawng awh.
Talai van kaawm e hno dawk na lung pen awh hanh. Kahlun lae hnonaw dawk na lung pen awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nangmouh teh na due awh toung dawkvah, nangmae hringnae teh Khrih hoi cungtalah Cathut thung hro lah ao toe.
Maimae hringnae lah kaawm e Khrih a kamnue toteh maimouh hai ama hoi cungtalah bawilen laihoi kamnue awh van han.
Hatdawkvah, ka kamsoumhoehe napui tongpa yonnae, kaisuenae, lungradueknae, kathout lah onae, meikaphawk bawknae lah kaawm e hounlounnae, het talai van kaawm e pueng hah dout sak awh.
Hetnaw kecu dawk Cathut lungkhueknae teh a lawk ka tarawi hoeh e naw koevah a pha.
Nangmouh hai ahmaloe teh hotnaw dawk ka hring e lah na o awh.
Hatei atuteh, lungkhueknae, Lungphuennae, hmuhmanae, tounkhouknae, kakhin e lawk deinae kaawm e pueng hah nangmae pahni dawk hoi takhoe awh.
Tami karuem hoi a sakenaw hah na takhoe awh hnukkhu, buet touh hoi buet touh kâdum awh hanh.
A katang e lungangnae hoi sak katha lah kaawm e tami katha, kasakkung e mei ka lat e hah kâmahrawk awh toe.

Hote sak katha e dawk teh Grik, Judah, vuensoma e, vuensoma hoeh e, tamipathunaw, tamimathengnaw, san, tami kahlout, tie awmhoeh toe. Khrih teh hnocawngca kuepcingnae lah ao teh hnocawngca thung hai ao.   
\s1 Khrih tami hringnae
Hatdawkvah, Cathut ni rawi e tami, thoungsak e tami, a lungpataw e tami lah na o awh e patetlah pahrenpavainae, pahrenlungmanae, kârahnoumnae, lungdolungnemnae, lungsawnae naw hah khohnat awh.
Buet touh hoi buet touh yon kâtoun kawi awm pawiteh Khrih ni na ngaithoum awh e patetlah buet touh hoi buet touh yon kângaithoum awh.
Kuepcingnae lah kaawm e lungpatawnae hah patuen khohnat sin awh.
Nangmae lungthung vah, Khrih e lungmawngnae ni uk seh. Hottelah hanelah doeh nangmouh teh tak buet touh thung kaw e lah na o awh. A lung kahawi e lah awm awh.
Khrih e a lawkkatang teh nangmouh thungvah yikkawi naseh. Nangmouh teh Sam la, Cathut pholennae la, muitha la aphunphun sak awh nateh, buet touh hoi buet touh kâhroecoenae, tha kâpahmeinae, tawn awh.
Lawk na dei nakunghai, a thaw na tawk nakunghai, bangpueng Bawipa Jisuh Khrih e min lahoi yah, tawksak awh. A lungmanae teh a len tangngak ti hoi Pa Cathut hmalah lunghawinae lawk dei awh.
Yunaw, Bawipa dawk na o awh e patetlah vânaw e uknae rahim vah awm awh.
Vanaw, na yunaw hah lungpataw awh. Kuekluekhmailuek tet awh hanh.
Camonaw, manu na pa e lawk hah ngâi awh. Manu na pa e lawkngainae teh, Bawipa ni a ngai e hno doeh.
Napanaw, canaw hah a lungphuen sak awh hanh. A lung na phuen sak awh pawiteh, a lung a pout awh han.
Sannaw, Bawipa taket awh nateh, tami lunghawi nahane dueng lah mithmu dueng tawk awh hanh. Lunghring laipalah, talai bawinaw e lawk hah ngâi awh.
Tami e thaw dueng ka tawk e lah pouk laipalah, Bawipa e a thaw ka tawk e lah pouk awh nateh, lungthocalah hoi bangpueng tawk awh.
Nangmouh teh Bawipa Khrih e thaw tawkkung lah na o awh dawkvah, râw teh tawkphu lah Bawipa kut dawk hoi na coe a han tie panuek awh.
Kamsoumhoehe hno ka sak e tami teh, ama ni a tawk e aphu hah a hmu han. Apihai ngaima tanae awm mahoeh.

Bawinaw, nangmae Bawi teh kalvan vah ao tie panuek awh nateh, na sannaw koe kahman lah, kahawi e hno sak awh.   
\s1 Alouke lawkthuinaenaw
Pou ratoum awh nateh, lunghawilawkdeinae hoi khenyawn awh.
Kai teh Khrih e hrolawk kecu dawk sumrui hoi katek lah ka o dawkvah,

Hote hrolawk hah pâpho nahanelah Cathut ni takhang a paawng nahan, hote hrolawk teh pâpho hane kawi lah ao dawkvah, ka pâpho thai nahan, kaimouh hane lahai ratoum awh.   
\s1 Ahnoungpoung lawkthuinae
Alawilae taminaw e minhmai khet laihoi, lungangnae lahoi kâroe awh nateh, atueng hah hno panuek awh.
Tami pueng bangtelane let ka pato han tie na panue thai awh nahan, nangmae na lawk dei e teh palawi patetlah paan sak awh nateh, pout laipalah lungmanae lah pou awm naseh.
Bawipa dawk yuemkamcu e, Bawipa e a san lah rei kaawm awh e, ka lungpataw e ka nawngha Taisikas ni kaie a konglam kaawm e pueng teh na dei pouh han doeh.
Ahni teh nangmae konglam koung a panue dawkvah nangmouh lung na pahawi nahanlah,
nangmouh thung e yuemkamcu e hoi ka lungpataw e ka nawngha Onesimus hoi ahni teh reirei a tho roi han. Ahnimouh roi ni hie khothung e kamthang pueng hah nangmouh koe a dei roi han.

Kai hoi thongim rei ka bawt e Aristarkas, Barnabas e a pahringca Mark, Justus telah a kaw awh e Jisuh tinaw ni kut na man awh. Mark hanelah nangmouh koe lawk na thui awh toe. Nangmouh koe a tho toteh dawn awh.
Vuensom a lah kaawm e naw dawkvah, ahnimouh dueng doeh Cathut uknaeram hanelah kai hoi reirei ka tawk e lah kaawm niteh, ka lung ahawi sak awh.
Nangmouh thung e Khrih Jisuh e a san Epaphras ni nangmanaw kut na man awh. Nangmouh na cue awh teh, Cathut ngainae dawk kacaklah na kangdue awh nahan, nangmouh hanelah a kâyawm teh ouk a ratoum.
Ahni teh nangmouh hane hoi, Laodicea kho kaawmnaw hane hoi, Hierapolis kho kaawmnaw hanelah a lung ka tho roeroe e doeh titeh kai ni ka kampangkhai .
Ka lungpataw e tâsibawi Luk hoi Demas ni kut na man awh.
Laodicea kho kaawm e hmaunawnghanaw, Nimpha hoi ahni im kaawm e kawhmoun hah kutman awh.
Hete ca heh, nangmouh ni na touk awh hnukkhu vah, Laodicea kawhmoun hai touk sak awh. Hote kho koehoi e ca hai nangmouh ni touk van awh.
Arkhippas koe hai, Bawipa koehoi na coe e thaw hah, kuep sak nahanelah kâhruetcuet loe tet pouh awh.
Kai Pawl ni nangmouh kutmannae ca hah ka mae kut hoi ka thut. Ka khang e kateknae hah pahnim awh hanh. A lungmanae nangmouh koe awm lawiseh. Amen.
